text:
SY327
Interviews and Focus Groups
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An introduction to the skills needed to conduct and analyze in-depth interviews and
focus groups, both of which are key methodological techniques in qualitative social
research. Emphasis will be on research design, the development of questions,
interviewing and moderating techniques, and data analysis.
Students
will have an
opportunity to practice key skills.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY281
